glossary.definition: (1) "Renter" means a person who owns rented property.
glossary.source_title: Section 2913.72 - Evidence of an intent to commit theft of rented property.

glossary.definition: (2) "Rentee" means a person who pays consideration to a renter for the use of rented property.
glossary.source_title: Section 2913.72 - Evidence of an intent to commit theft of rented property.
